newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-David Jones to open New Zealand store.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-David Jones to open New Zealand store.

text.p: Upmarket department store retailer David Jones Ltd said on Thursday it plans to open its first store outside Australia, in Auckland, New Zealand, in 1999.

Chief executive Chris Tideman said the store would be anchor tenant in a major new Auckland mall development, Quay Park Mall, which would be New Zealand's biggest retail development with three major tenants, food courts, and 175 shops.
The David Jones store will occupy 19,500 square metres of the 60,000 square metres lettable area in the complex.
David Jones currently operates 32 stores in Australia.
